hero.headline: Open arts for AI coding agents.
hero.sub_copy: Multi-model adversarial review, local-first. The same swarm.yaml runs on Claude, Codex, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
hero.tagline: kai (開) + jutsu (術) — open + skill. Sometimes kaiju (怪獣) — monster. Always kaizen (改善) — improvement.

failure_demo.intro: Single-agent review is sycophancy by default. Same prompt, same model, run twice — you usually get the same "looks good." Adversarial review needs structural disagreement, not just rerolls.
failure_demo.outro: kaijutsu fans the same diff out across multiple models, surfaces where they agree, and flags exactly where they don't. The disagreement table is the artifact you actually read.
failure_demo.left_body: Reviewed the v0.13.0 final pr-review pre-fix. "LGTM — clean rename, well-scoped, tests look comprehensive."
failure_demo.right_body: DeepSeek (paranoid-security persona) caught validateUserPresetEntry dropping Mode/Personas/ConfidenceFloor at parse time. Claude and Gemini both green-lit. The bug was real. We fixed it (commit 83476ef).

portability.intro: Write a swarm.yaml once. jutsu dispatches it across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek-via-HTTP, and whatever vendor ships next. v0.6's driver abstraction handles the wire format per vendor; v0.13's Preset SDK lets you compose your own pipelines. Vendor lock-in stays a vendor problem.
portability.snippet_yaml:
# .kaijutsu/swarm.yaml — composable, portable, version-controlled
version: 1
presets:
  - name: tight-pr-review
    base: pr-review
    personas:
      - default-claude
      - paranoid-security-claude
      - default-gemini
    mode: full
    confidence_floor: 0.7
portability.callout_body: Vendor IDEs will ship native multi-agent review by 2027. Cross-vendor portability is the part that doesn't commodify. Your pipeline is yours, regardless of which vendor wins.

cost.intro: Multi-agent review costs more per call than a single-agent run. The framing the spreadsheet wants is cost per bug actually caught and confirmed real, not cost per call.
cost.table_caption: Real numbers from the v0.14.0 stage-2 doc-review run on the landing-page content spec (this page's spec).
cost.objection_title: But isn't this 3x more expensive than a single-agent run?
cost.objection_body: Yes — and that's the point. Three models with different priors disagree about different things. The cost difference is what buys you the disagreement.

parts.title: Skill provenance
parts.body: Core skills (skills/core/*) are sigstore-signed at release. jutsu install verifies the signature before unpacking. Community skills are pinned to a tagged commit + SHA in kaijutsu.lock.json; tampering breaks the lockfile.

parts.title: Permission gates
parts.body: jutsu install parses each skill's permissions: manifest before write. Bash, network, fs-write are explicit; jutsu install prompts on first use of a sensitive permission and records the decision.

parts.title: Local data stays local
parts.body: ~/.kaijutsu/findings.db (the quality fingerprinting store) is mode 0600, never leaves disk, never syncs anywhere. The cli/internal/cli/finding.go package is import-list-restricted from net, net/http, net/url — enforced as a build-time test.

parts.title: Receipts, not rhetoric
parts.body: Every kaijutsu release links to the actual jutsu swarm pr-review run that reviewed itself. (Self-review is necessary, not sufficient — but it's a falsifiable receipt, not a marketing badge.)

trust.wrapper_title: Isn't this just a wrapper around OpenAI/Anthropic APIs?
trust.wrapper_intro: The honest answer: it has wrapper parts and non-wrapper parts.
trust.wrapper_inside: Per-vendor driver shims (cli/http/cli-compat/mcp). Intentionally thin — vendor APIs change, and we want the change surface small.
wrapper_outside: Cross-vendor portability layer — same swarm.yaml runs across vendors with different wire formats and auth.

findings.db quality fingerprinting — per-(provider, persona, preset, codebase) precision math derived from your accept/dismiss history. The synthesizer weights each agent's vote by observed precision. No vendor offers this.
Preset SDK — compose your own swarm shapes; project + home overlay; built-ins shadowed at registration.
Dream lens-blindspot warnings — jutsu swarm dream --mode full --lenses all runs the 8-lens matrix and flags where lens consensus may be RLHF-convergence rather than actual signal.
agents.yaml driver abstraction — provider catalog with overlay + override semantics; vendor switch is a config edit.

contributing.intro: Skills + tools live at github.com/momentmaker/kaijutsu. Read CONTRIBUTING.md for skill authoring + PR conventions.
contributing.body: Want to add a skill? jutsu skill new <name> scaffolds a flat-layout skill directory. jutsu lint <path> validates schema + license + permission manifest. Run jutsu publish to open a PR against skills/community/.
